title: Signing Policy
description:
Which PGP signing keys may vouch for which artifacts.

The configuration's 'signing-keys' supply key material; this file says whose signature counts for what.  A key the rules name vouches only for the artifacts those rules cover, and an artifact the rules cover is vouched for only by the keys they name.  A pinned key the file never mentions vouches for everything, as it does with no file at all; a key fetched from a keyserver vouches only where a rule names it, since a keyserver supplies material, not trust.  A valid signature by a key that does not vouch for the artifact reports 'signature-key-unvouched'.

rules.title: Key Assignments
rules.description: Every rule covering an artifact contributes its keys; order does not matter.

purl.description: Which artifacts, as a purl whose name is a glob ('pkg:maven/org.apache.*/*') and whose version, when given, is a RANGE in the artifact's own ecosystem ('pkg:maven/org.example/lib@[2.0,)').  A purl naming no version covers every version.

fingerprints.description: The primary-key fingerprints allowed to vouch for these artifacts: 40 hexadecimal digits for a version 4 key, 64 for version 6.  Spaces and a leading '0x' are ignored.  Short and long key ids are refused, since a key id can be forged where a fingerprint cannot.

justification.description: Where the assignment comes from: the project's KEYS file, a release announcement.
